instruction: Set up Thunderbird to send emails from multiple aliases (alias1@outlook.com, alias2@outlook.com, alias3@outlook.com) without adding or configuring any email accounts. I just need outgoing capability for these aliases.

metadata.explanation: Task is infeasible because Thunderbird requires at least one configured account with SMTP server settings to send emails. Setting up outgoing-only functionality for multiple aliases without any account configuration violates Thunderbird's architectural requirements.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses the 'infeasible' function to mark this task as impossible to complete
The technical reasoning is sound: Thunderbird's architecture requires SMTP server configuration to send emails, making outgoing-only capability without account configuration impossible
The metadata provides clear explanation of why the task violates Thunderbird's architectural requirements
Using 'infeasible' evaluator is the appropriate and semantically correct way to handle tasks that cannot be completed as described in the instruction
